values.note: recreation.gov rate table, Peak Season 2026-05-01 to 2026-09-30 (the same for 2027): primitive (non-electric) sites $28 a night, standard electric $34, full hookup $46. The non-electric sites take vehicles 40-50 ft.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10122583/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-01..2026-09-30 and 2027-05-01..2027-09-30: Primitive site 28, Standard electric campsites 34, Full Hookup campsites 46) + RIDB catalog (STANDARD NONELECTRIC sites Max Vehicle Length 40-50), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10122583 ('There are eight full hook-up campsites, 26 electric campsites, and 44 primitive campsites') + RIDB catalog (29 sites 30-amp, 4 sites 50-amp, 8 with Water Hookup, all reservable standard sites), read 2026-10-21

values.note: recreation.gov says 77 sites (8 full hookup, 26 electric, 44 primitive); the catalog's 77 include two management sites, leaving 75 public: 32 electric and 43 non-electric. Vehicle lengths 40-50 ft; five pull-throughs, the rest back-in.

sites.source: RIDB campsite catalog for facility 10122583 (75 reservable STANDARD sites + 2 MANAGEMENT; Max Vehicle Length 40/45/50; 5 Pull-through) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10122583 ('Choose from 77 sites'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: A shower house and restroom inside the campground; camp host on site; accessible boat ramp listed among the amenities.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10122583 ('There is a shower house and restroom inside the campground'; amenities 'Accessible Flush Toilets', 'Accessible Drinking Water', 'Accessible Showers', 'Host', 'Accessible Boat Ramp'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: All 75 public sites are reservable on recreation.gov; reservations close 2 days before arrival. No weekend or holiday minimum (rec.gov's soft minimums are 0). No more than 14 days in any 30 at Sutton Lake.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10122583 (facility_rules maxStay 14 per Rolling 30 Days, reservationCutOff 2, minWeekendStay 0 soft, minHolidayWeekendStay 0 soft; notice 'No person(s) may camp at one or more campsites for more than 14 days in a 30 day consecutive period at "Sutton Lake"') + RIDB catalog (every STANDARD site reservable), read 2026-10-21

note: USACE campground on the Elk River at Sutton Lake with waterfront sites. --Claude
summary: rec.gov page, rates and catalog: fees $28-46 confirmed; 50-amp/water confirmed (were derived) and sewer added (8 full-hookup sites); added 75 public sites to 50 ft with five pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets/drinking water, 14-night max, no minimums. Season not stated (rate seasons only); FCFS not stated (every site reservable). Run by the Corps: rec.gov names no concessioner and its contact is the Corps' Sutton Lake office (Suttonlake@usace.army.mil); the Corps' Huntington District Sutton Lake page refused the request. Note corrected: it is on the Elk River at Sutton Lake (rec.gov's 'Sutton Lake' rules), not Burnsville Lake; dropped the bare campingprepper.com listicle URL.
